data.desc: Lithium Americas is building Thacker Pass, located in Humboldt County, in northern Nevada. Phase 1 is designed for nominal production capacity of 40,000 tonnes per year of battery-quality lithium carbonate, and mechanical completion is targeted for late 2027. Thacker Pass hosts the largest known measured lithium resource (Measured and Indicated) in the world and is owned by a JV between Lithium Americas and GM. The DOE holds LAC Warrants to purchase common shares equivalent to a 5% equity stake of the Company as of the Issuance Date, as well as JV Warrants to purchase a non-voting, non-transferable equity interest in the JV equivalent to a 5% interest as of the Issuance Date.
